# Security Auditing

## Cloud Computing Risks

## Security Audit Costs

> **TODO (figure):** security audit costs — from slides.tex

## Security Auditing

* review / examination or infrastructure resources and procedures
* compliance
* typically independent auditor
* report, recommendations

## Security Review

* personnel
* infrastructure
* hardware
* software
* physical access
* encryption
* processes

## Test, Assess, Audit

* test: validate if it works or not (unit testing, pen testing)
* assess: match against expectation (vulnerability, risk assessment)
* audit: validate procedures, policies; compliance

## Types of Security Audits

* Penetration Test
* Compliance Audit
* Risk Assessment
* Vulnerability Test
* Due Dilligence Questionnaires

## Audit Targets

* data security
* operational security
* network security
* system security
* physical security

## Audit Types

* regular audit
* event-triggered audit
* external audit

## Purpose

* roadmap of weaknesses
* develop risk assessment plans
* snapshot of security state
* compliance audit (for certifications, attestations)

## Phases

* preliminary audit assessment
* planning and preparation
* establishing objectives
* performing review
* preparing report
* issuing review report

# System Security Auditing

## System Auditing Targets

* filesystem
* databases
* accounts & passwords
* network services
* applications (executables, processes)
* kernel
* hardware

## Filesystem

* ownership, permissions, capabilities
* timestamps
* partitions, disks, filesystems

## Databases

* access permissions
* data encryption, password encryption
* remote accessibility
* replication

## Accounts & Passwords

* access history
* password age
* failed attempts
* session lenghts
* origin of access

## Applications

* static & dynamic analysis, vulnerability assessment
* checksum
* resource access, monitoring

## Network Services

* open ports
* connection history
* access monitoring

## Kernel

* <https://github.com/a13xp0p0v/linux-kernel-defence-map>
* system call monitoring
* secure boot

## Hardware

* connected devices
* firmware version, contents
* bootloader, boot firmware
* side channels

# auditd

## auditd

* Linux auditing daemon
* event collection of system activities
* available as logs to be investigated subsequently

## auditd flow

> **TODO (figure):** Linux audit flow — from slides.tex

## auditd Use Cases

* file access
* system calls
* run commands
* execution of system pathnames
* security events
* network access

## Components

* `auditd` service
* `auditctl` to define rules: system calls, files, users, pids
* `augenrules` generate rules
* `ausearch`, `aureport`: process logs

## Event Viewer (Windows)

* collection of event logs in Windows
* Security Logs for security audits
* Event Viewer used to view them in GUI

# Penetration Testing

## Penetration Testing

* detect vulnerabilities
* exploit vulnerabilities
* from the position of the attacker
* ethical hacking

## PenTest Phases

![Penetration testing phases.](img/pentest-phases.png){fig-align="center"}

## Attack Phases

* Reconnaissance
* Weaponization
* Delivery
* Exploitation
* Installation
* Command and Control
* Action on Objectives

## Pentesting Distros

* Kali Linux: <https://www.kali.org/>
* Parrot: <https://www.parrotsec.org/>

## Tools of the Trade

* nmap, shodan, whois
* Nessus
* OpenVAS
* nikto
* Metasploit, pupy
* Burp
* XSSer
* SQLmap

## Ethical Hacking

* security testing of system, application, network
* same tools as black hat hackers
* approval from owner of targeted system
